text:
maria: Quick heads-up - StratusCloud + NebulaHW joint webinar set for Sept 12, 10:00am PT. Need run-of-show, speaker confirmations, and swag + shipping timeline.
kevin: Thanks - confirmed from partnerships side. Are we doing the hardware live demo or a pre-recorded fallback?
sam: We should aim for live but have a pre-recorded fallback stored on S3 (meet failure mode).
jess: NebulaHW asked for a 15min slot for the live demo (hardware + Redwood Dedicated). Can we give them 12-18?
tom: 15 is fine. Need to know model & seq length so I can tune the runtime configs. tom -> would like p99/latency target and batch hints.
nalini: Speaker confirmations: Maria (Redwood), Eve (Stratus product lead), Tony (Nebula HW eng). Can we get headshots and bios by EOD Wed?
eve-partner: I can send the bio + slide deck by Wednesday morning. Also we need a line about marketplace announcement (Stratus listing).
maria: Perfect. Marketplace blurb: "Available Sept 12: Redwood-integrated StratusCloud listing with NebulaHW-optimized images" - draft copy to review?
kevin: LGTM, maybe add a note about "try with dedicated capacity" CTA.
sam: Run-of-show draft - please review: ```
0:00-0:02 intro + housekeeping (maria)
0:02-0:07 Redwood product + quick benchmarks (sam)
0:07-0:22 Nebula live demo (tony) - model load, quantized perf, failover to pre-recorded clip if needed
0:22-0:28 Stratus marketplace & partner announcement (eve)
0:28-0:30 CTA + closing (maria)
```
jess: Rehearsal windows? Propose Sept 10 3pm PT for a full run, Sept 11 10am PT quick mic check.
tony-partner: Tony here, Sept 10 works for a full dress. Need access to a test instance with Dedicated pool credentials.
maria: I'll create temporary tokens and share in a secure channel. shipbot: Shipping reminder - swag cutoff to carrier is Sept 3 for international.
shipbot: ETA computed: domestic label creation Aug 30, intl manifests Sept 2.
kevin: Swag list: 200 stickers, 150 shirts (mix S/M/L), 30 demo kits (power bricks + dongles), 50 partner co-branded hoodies. Who owns procurement?
jess: Partnerships budget covers stickers + hoodies. Demo kits procurement on ops (tom) and Nebula will provide the HW modules.
tom: I'll coordinate with Fulfillment to assemble kits. Need Nebula serial numbers for CARE tags. Tony, can you share?
tony-partner: Will share CSV by EOD Friday. Also tagging compliance: any customs docs needed for EU shipments?
kevin: Yes - we'll need commercial invoice + packing list; Fulfillment has templates. I'll ping you the EU customs template.
nalini: Checklist for speakers: 1) 1-slide bio, 2) demo access + test creds, 3) short bullet script for demo handoff. Deadline: Sept 6.
maria: Can someone own the PR blurb coordination with Stratus? We need a consolidated announcement that mentions the marketplace listing and the joint demo.
eve-partner: Stratus PR will draft; Maria please loop in comms.
kevin: I'll cc @comms in the doc, and schedule a 30min sync with Stratus PR next Tue.
sam: Action items recap: 
- Maria: secure tokens + comms loop (by Aug 29)
- Kevin: customs template + PR sync (by Aug 30)
- Jess: rehearsal schedule invites (by Aug 30)
- Tom: Fulfillment lead for demo kits + coordinate serials (by Sept 1)
- Tony (Nebula): CSV of serials + on-site checklist (by Aug 25)
- Eve (Stratus): marketplace blurb + speaker deck (by Sept 4)
Everyone: bios + headshots by Sept 4.
kevin: small ask - can we pre-record a 60s backup demo clip and upload to shared drive? Less stress on live switchovers.
tom: Agreed. I'll record a clean run and drop the mp4 in the shared folder.
maria: Thanks all - I'll post the rehearsal invites and a single doc with links + credentials in #private-partnerops once tokens are ready. :thumbsup: 
shipbot: Reminder: SWAG cutover in 6 days for domestic labels.
kevin: Great progress. If no objections I'll lock the run-of-show and rehearsal times tomorrow morning.
eve-partner: No objections from Stratus. Looking forward to it!
tony-partner: All good from Nebula.
maria: Closing thread - will update doc and ping when invites sent.
